data.name: DoubleTree by Hilton Santiago Kennedy
data.address: Av. Pdte. Kennedy 4422, 7630638 Vitacura, Región Metropolitana, Chile
data.description:
In a contemporary curved tower adjacent to Avenida Presidente Kennedy, this streamlined hotel is 12 km from central Plaza de Armas.
Understated rooms have neutral color schemes, and city or mountain views. All come with flat-screen TVs and free Wi-Fi, plus minibars, coffeemakers and safes. Suites add wet bars and separate living areas. Room service is available.
A breakfast buffet is complimentary. Amenities include a sophisticated top-floor restaurant and bar with floor-to-ceiling windows and sweeping views. There's also a seasonal outdoor pool and a hot tub, plus a fitness center, a lobby bar and a pool bar. Meeting facilities are available.
